title: Grilled Smoked Polish Sausage with Potatoes
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring grilled smoked polish sausage paired with roasted potatoes, perfect for a casual dinner.
instructions: Season the potatoes with salt, pepper, and aromatic herbs.
Grill the potatoes for about 20-25 minutes or until tender, turning occasionally.
Grill the smoked polish sausage for about 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the sausage rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced sausage with the roasted potatoes.
